request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only his skin colour: the face, ears, chest, belly, arms, hands, legs and feet become a much lighter, medium true goblin green like moss, with a darker green shadow tone, so the face and body are clearly visible; not black, not yellow. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather headband, chest strap, wrist wraps and loincloth, the belt, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
